missions.name: Welcome Home
intro: Marta: Nico Vale. Three years away and the district hasn't forgotten you.
Marta: Take the sedan. Meet me at the Aurora Cafe downtown. Don't scratch it.
outro: Marta: Not bad. The Harbor Kings run the docks now. We need to know how deep they are.

missions.name: Old Haunts
intro: Marta: Walk the old streets. Let people see you are back. Start at the beach.
outro: Marta: Word travels fast. Lio at the workshop has a pickup for you.

missions.name: Special Delivery
intro: Lio: Crate in the back, warehouse in the industrial district. Do not open it.
Lio: And Nico, drive like a citizen.

objs.text: Deliver the crate to the warehouse

outro: Dock Foreman: Tell Lio we are square.

missions.name: Dead Drop
intro: Inspector Okoye: I never met you. Two dead drops downtown. Find what the Kings hid.

lines: Okoye: Shipping manifests. Dante Rossi signs them all.
Okoye: Find where the Kings meet. Then make noise.

missions.name: Shake the Tail
intro: Marta: Okoye's name just reached the Kings. Police are circling, someone tipped them.
outro: Marta: Clean. Here, a present from the dealership.

missions.name: Harbor Kings
intro: Marta: Four of Dante's guys are guarding the marina office. Clear them out.
outro: Marta: That got his attention. Take the SUV from their lot.

missions.name: Vehicle Recovery
intro: Lio: They took my sports car for a joyride. It is in the industrial lot. Bring it back to the garage.
outro: Lio: Not a scratch. Okay, a small scratch.

missions.name: Rossi's Run
intro: Okoye: Dante's courier is on the road with the ledger. Stop him. Wreck the car, grab the book.
outro: Okoye: Good. The ledger points to a meeting at the docks.

missions.name: Debts
intro: Dante Rossi: Nico. We used to be friends.
Dante: Walk away and I forget your face.

lines: Dante: No? Then boys, show him the door.

outro: Marta: He is cornered. One last move, and it is at the industrial yard.

missions.name: Last District
intro: Marta: Dante hides in the industrial yard. End it, Nico.
Marta: Santa Lucia is yours to save.
outro: Okoye: It is over. Santa Lucia owes you.

missions.name: Beach Courier
intro: Beach vendor: Three parcels, three stalls. You have three minutes!

missions.name: Street Time Trial
intro: Racer: Four checkpoints. Any car. Beat the clock.

missions.name: Hit List
intro: Informant: Three Kings stragglers are still on the east side.
